_README.purpose: CURATED OVERLAY for the PAL OpenRouter registry — the ONLY file edited by hand. scripts/build_registry.py merges it onto the upstream bundled registry (conf/openrouter_models.json of sergiobe31/pal-mcp-server at the SHA pinned in .mcp.json) to generate config/pal_openrouter_models.json.
_README.authorship: Sergio + Claude (cross-model-toolkit). Entries verified against OpenRouter /api/v1/models at the dates noted in history.
_README.how_to: 'models' holds full entries, appended to (or replacing, by model_name) the upstream base. 'overrides' holds field-level patches applied to upstream base entries by model_name — used to force supports_extended_thinking:false on upstream models whose reasoning we have NOT verified, so the shipped default reasons only on the curated entries. To change a flag or add a model: edit this file, then run scripts/build_registry.py.
